## Deduplicated & Verified Source Records

### THE MetaNet NETWORK ENVIRONMENT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODULAR NEURAL NETWORKS
- Year: 1990
- Authors: Jacob M. J. Murre, Steven E. Kleynenberg
- Venue: International Neural Network Conference (INNC-90, Paris)
- DOI: 10.1007/978-94-009-0643-3_59
- PDF: https://kleynenberg.compapers/murre-kleynenberg-1990-metanet-innc.pdf
- Summary: Introduces the MetaNet network environment for building, examining, and simulating modular neural networks, featuring a graphical editor, network compiler, MetaNet specification language, and parallel hardware drivers.

### Extending the MetaNet Network Environment: Process Control and Machine Independence
- Year: 1991
- Authors: Jacob M. J. Murre, Steven E. Kleynenberg
- Venue: International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN-91, Helsinki)
- PDF: https://kleynenberg.compapers/murre-kleynenberg-1991-extending-metanet-icann.pdf
- Summary: Presents the MetaNet Network Environment as a general parallel neurosimulator supporting diverse neural network paradigms and parallel hardware, addressing object representation, concurrent process control, and machine independence.

### Integrating the BSP400 neurocomputer with the MetaNet Network Environment
- Year: 1991
- Authors: J. M. J. Murre, S. E. Kleynenberg, J. N. H. Heemskerk, P. T. W. Hudson
- Venue: International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN-91, Singapore)
- DOI: 10.1109/IJCNN.1991.170608
- PDF: https://kleynenberg.compapers/murre-et-al-1991-bsp400-metanet-ijcnn.pdf
- Summary: Describes the integration of the BSP400 massively parallel neurocomputer with the MetaNet neural network design environment via dedicated hardware drivers mapping network definitions onto parallel processors.

### Patent WO 2014/003543 A1 — Method, system and computer program for generating a query representation of a document
- Year: 2014
- Co-Inventors: Steven Kleynenberg, Huub Rutten, Elsemiek ten Pas
- Patent URL: https://google.com
- PDF: https://kleynenberg.compapers/WO2014003543A1.pdf
- Summary: Describes a deterministic linguistic method and system for generating a query representation of an electronic document by identifying word sequences matching predetermined part-of-speech (POS) categories for document retrieval and clustering.

### Remote Collaboration, Decision Support, and On-Demand Medical Image Analysis for Acute Stroke Care (MEDUSA)
- Year: 2015
- Venue: European Conference on Service-Oriented and Cloud Computing (ESOCC)
- DOI: 10.1007/978-3-319-24072-5_15
- PDF: https://kleynenberg.compapers/sales-barros-et-al-2015-medusa-acute-stroke-esocc.pdf
- Summary: Presents MEDUSA, a platform supporting acute stroke care through rapid medical data exchange, automated image analysis, clinical decision support, and remote collaboration.
